{{Quote|Commander, we just lost Blue Squadron!|Red Leader at the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]|<ref name="SW:CW">{{CW|10}}</ref>}}
'''Blue Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that flew a variety of craft, including [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]], [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wings]], and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Blue Squadron developed from a [[Blue Squadron (Jedi Order)|unit]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]<ref name="Republic50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref> into a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. This Blue Squadron fought in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], flying [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Its pilots assisted in the destruction of the orbital [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|gun platforms]], though the squadron was wiped out when [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] joined the fray in her [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]].<ref name="SW:CW" />

Later in the war, a Blue Squadron was under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]. Flying a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], Gallia's V-19 Torrent squadron was accompanied by Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in defense of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|diplomatic cruiser]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], with Blue Squadron engaging and crippling the pirate mothership.<ref name="Republic61" />

Blue Squadron flew V-19 starfighters at the [[Battle of Rendili]], in which the squadron lost at least a third of its strength.<ref name="SWR:TDOR">[[Republic 70|''Republic'' 70]]</ref>

When [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Anakin Skywalker secured [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Blue Squadron was outfitted with a flight of them bearing blue markings, thereby augmenting the V-19s that they fielded.<ref name="SWPMTCG">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=Blue Squadron Y-wing}}</ref>

[[File:BattleOfUkio-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Blue Squadron at the [[battle of Ukio]]]]
Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] flew a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] as [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]], commanding a Blue Squadron of V-19 torrents at the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. During the battle Blue Squadron sustained heavy losses after Ahsoka disobeyed a direct order to retreat.<ref name="SoR" />

At the [[battle of Ukio]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Keelyvine Reus]], commanded Blue Squadron against the CIS invasion force that assaulted the planet. The Separatist's had released electromagnetic soil from [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] which clung to the [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. They engineered the soil to be photoreactive so that it moved along the shield as the planet rotated around it's sun, created an artificial and mobile solar eclipse which threatened to destroy all the valuable crops on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]. A section of the planetary shield had to be dropped to allow the soil to dissipate in the atmosphere. Blue squadron assaulted the CIS forces to prevent them taking advantage of the opening the shield and directly assault the planet below.<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>

After the development of the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter]], Blue Squadron was among the units in the Republic fleet to receive ARC-170s for combat and utilized them at the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].<ref name="Republic77" /> The pilots of the ARC-170s favored a configuration that provided more power to weapons than to shields, when compared to [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="SWPMTCG" /> At this time, the squadron also included [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]] flown by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] including [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]],<ref name="Republic74">[[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]]</ref> and [[Xiaan Amersu]], who served as Blue Leader in the siege's final battle, in which she sacrificed herself by flying her damaged starfighter into a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] planetary gun.<ref name="Republic77" />

==Behind the scenes==
While Adi Gallia's entry in [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Databank (original)|Databank]] refers to her as the leader of Red Squadron during Bail Organa's rescue from pirates,<ref name="AGDB">{{DB|character|adigallia|Gallia, Adi}}</ref> the comic issue [[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]], the original source, portrays Gallia as Blue Squadron's leader, with Plo Koon commanding Red Squadron.<ref name="Republic61" />
